unit_label: Dark Launching — bliki entry (Martin Fowler, dated 29 April 2020)
representation_gap: Article figure images/dark-launch/sketch.png was not retrieved; content unknown.
claims_supported: Dark launching calls new or changed back-end behavior from existing users without revealing the call, to assess load and performance impact before public release.
A feature flag can switch the hidden behavior off in production before users notice an unacceptable impact.
Dark launching can compare old and new implementations while returning only one answer to the interface.
The source recommends canary release for behavior that depends on a user's choice, not dark launching.
claims_not_supported: Measured latency, throughput or error-rate effects
limitations: 387-word single-author definitional bliki entry; not a benchmark or production report.
